from common import *
import signal

if __name__=='__main__':
    save_source(__file__)
    h=read(BASE/'docs/source-label-handoff.json')
    for child in h['children']:
        pid=int(child[0])
        while True:
            r=subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','stat='],capture_output=True,text=True)
            if r.returncode or not r.stdout.strip() or r.stdout.strip().startswith('Z'):break
            time.sleep(5)
    _,variant,year=h['stage'].split('-')
    proof=BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{variant}-{year}.json'
    assert proof.is_file(),'Inspect inference failure before replacing coordinator'
    for item in read(proof)['predictions']:check(item['prediction_part'])
    pid=h['pid'];cmd=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','command='],text=True).strip()
    assert str(TMP/'pipeline_single.py') in cmd
    os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM);os.kill(pid,signal.SIGCONT)
    for n in ['evaluate_single','publish_single_v2','pipeline_single_v2']:save_source(TMP/(n+'.py'))
    harness('event',{'type':'note','text':'Before first candidate evaluation, versioned single-source evaluator now labels the old continuous control and user amendment explicitly in canonical JSON metadata. Versioned report marks bin occupancy as original new-input preflight, not old-target training counts. Current inference year completed and verified; coordinator handoff adds no fit and changes no metric algorithm or target.'})
    h.update(completed_at=time.time(),completed_inference=fingerprint(proof),replacement_pipeline='pipeline_single_v2.py');write(BASE/'docs/source-label-handoff.json',h)
    print('Source metadata handoff ready; prior annual inference retained exactly.',flush=True)
